summary.en: The persistent frame of a plakat film: the visible 12-column grid, a header with brand, tag, section and licence, a footer with URL, platforms and one progress cell per bar, and a static paper tooth.
summary.zh: plakat 片子一直在的画框：看得见的 12 栏网格，页眉写品牌、标语、当前章节和许可，页脚写网址、平台和每小节一格的进度条，再加一层静态纸纹。

fits: Every page of a plakat film; any Swiss-style film that wants its section and progress on screen.
notFor: Films without sections or a URL to show; dark spectacle films (the frame is print furniture).

intent.en: The film reads as one printed series: the grid shows the system, the header names where you are, the footer counts how far along it is.
intent.zh: 整片读起来是一套印刷系列：网格露出体系，页眉说明身在哪一节，页脚数着走到了哪。

content.en: Brand (≤ 16 chars), tag (≤ 42), section (≤ 20), licence, URL, platforms; the number of bars and the current one.
content.zh: 品牌（≤ 8 字）、标语（≤ 14 字）、章节（≤ 10 字）、许可、网址、平台；总小节数与当前小节。

fits.zh: plakat 每一页；任何想把章节和进度留在画面上的瑞士风片子。

notFor.zh: 没有章节或网址可示的片子；暗色大场面片（这个框是印刷用品）。

en: Over an accent field the chrome switches to onAccent at the field edge; pass the field rects or the label sinks to 2.5:1.
zh: 在强调色色块上，框的文字在色块边缘切换为 onAccent；不传色块范围，标签对比度会掉到 2.5:1。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
